headline_fact: In August 2026, Houthi rebels struck the Egyptian-owned, Tanzania-flagged cargo ship Tihamah in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, killing six people -- four crew members and two rescuers -- marking the first commercial shipping deaths from Houthi strikes since the previous fall, just as carriers including CMA CGM and Maersk had cautiously begun returning to the Red Sea.
